main_text.l: Galderæ. In illa A.C. 1430 quidam nomine Doramas, in hac Guauarta-ma regnabat. Insula Teneriffa Du-ces habuit novem liberâ electione succedentes.
Regnum Insularum Fortunatarum à Francis occupatum fuit.

Circa A.C. 1370 Robinus de Bracamonte, Franciæ Architalassus, has insulas pro filio suo Johanne de Betancourt regio titulo impetravit: qui, debellatis Barbaris, regem Canariæ, Lanzarotta, Fortaventuræ, Gomeræ, & Ferro se appellavit. Cui ordine succedêre Menardus, Petrus Barbæ, Ferdinandus Beraza & Didacus de Herrera, qui omne jus suum transtulit ad Ferdinandum Regem Hispaniæ;

page.notes: The first note "à Gallis occupatæ." stands beside the "Circa" line and the second "ad Hispanos translatæ." beside "tulit ad Ferdinandum"; both placed at their approximate margin position. The paragraph beginning "Circa" continues to the foot of the page. Last word "Hispaniæ;" is partly cut at the right edge; read as likely. Heading levels for "Periodus II." and "Explicatio." are my judgement from their typography.
